source: wago.tools DB2 wowf 1.60.1.70790 with hotfixes, plus the Forever client hotfix cache (build 70862, 5,223 records)

talents.name: Coup de Grace
ranks: Increases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by 20%, and the damage and storage rate of your Death Mark ability by 20%.

talents.name: Remorseless Attacks
ranks: After killing a non-trivial enemy, gives you a 0% increased critical strike chance on your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Mutilate, or Ghostly Strike. Lasts 20 sec.

talents.name: Malice
ranks: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks and Poisons by 5%.

talents.name: Ruthlessness
ranks: Gives your finishing moves a 60% chance to add a Combo Point to your target.

talents.name: Murder
ranks: Increases all damage dealt by 4% against Humanoid and Giant targets.

talents.name: Improved Slice and Dice
ranks: Increases the duration of your Slice and Dice ability by 15%.

talents.name: Relentless Strikes
ranks: Your finishing moves have a 0% chance per Combo Point to restore 25 Energy.

talents.name: Improved Expose Armor
ranks: Reduces the Energy cost of your Expose Armor ability by 10, and refunds 2 Combo Points when cast with 5 Combo Points.

talents.name: Lethality
ranks: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Sinister Strike, Gouge, Backstab, Mutilate, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities by 6%.

talents.name: Vile Poisons
ranks: Increases the damage dealt by your poisons by 20% and gives your poisons an additional 40% chance to resist dispel effects.

talents.name: Improved Poisons
ranks: Increases the chance to apply Poisons to your target by 10%, and gives Poison applications a 50% chance to not consume a charge.

talents.name: Cold Blood
ranks: When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by 100%.

talents.name: Improved Kidney Shot
ranks: Enemies Stunned by your Kidney Shot ability take 10% increased damage from your poisons and attacks.

talents.name: Seal Fate
ranks: Your critical strikes from abilities that add Combo Points have a 0% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

talents.name: Vigor
ranks: Increases your maximum Energy by 10.

talents.name: Improved Gouge
ranks: Increases the duration of your Gouge ability by 1.5 sec.

talents.name: Efficient Strikes
ranks: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sinister Strike and Hemorrhage abilities by 5.

talents.name: Lightning Reflexes
ranks: Increases your Dodge chance by 5%.

talents.name: Deflection
ranks: Increases your Parry chance by 1%.

talents.name: Precision
ranks: Improves your chance to hit by 1%.

talents.name: Endurance
ranks: Reduces the cooldown of your Sprint and Evasion abilities by 60%.

talents.name: Riposte
ranks: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack.

talents.name: Improved Sprint
ranks: Gives a 100% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when you activate your Sprint ability.

talents.name: Improved Kick
ranks: Gives your Kick ability a 100% chance to Silence the target for 2 sec.

talents.name: Hack and Slash
ranks: Increases your chance to get a critical strike with Daggers and Fist Weapons by 5%.

talents.name: Dual Wield Specialization
ranks: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 50%.

talents.name: Hack and Slash
ranks: Your attacks with Maces ignore up to 15% of your target's armor.

talents.name: Blade Flurry
ranks: Increases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec.

talents.name: Hack and Slash
ranks: Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon. |CFFFFFFFFAxe/Sword:|R Your successful melee attacks have a 5% chance to trigger an extra attack on the target. |CFFFFFFFFDagger/Fist:|R Increases your critical strike chance by 5%. |CFFFFFFFFMace:|R Your attacks ignore 15% of your target's armor.

talents.name: Fist Weapon Specialization
ranks: Increases your chance to get a critical strike with Fist Weapons by 1%.
Increases your chance to get a critical strike with Fist Weapons by 2%.
Increases your chance to get a critical strike with Fist Weapons by 3%.
Increases your chance to get a critical strike with Fist Weapons by 4%.
Increases your chance to get a critical strike with Fist Weapons by 5%.

talents.name: Weapon Expertise
ranks: Reduces the chance for your attacks to be Dodged or Parried by 2%.

talents.name: Aggression
ranks: Increases the damage of your Sinister Strike and Eviscerate abilities by 2%.

talents.name: Adrenaline Rush
ranks: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.

talents.name: Master of Deception
ranks: Reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while in Stealth mode as if you were 3 levels higher.

talents.name: Opportunity
ranks: Increases the damage dealt by your Backstab, Garrote, Ambush, and Mutilate abilities by 10%.

talents.name: Sleight of Hand
ranks: Reduces the chance you are critically hit by attacks by 2% and increases the threat reduction of your Feint ability by 20%.

talents.name: Elusiveness
ranks: Reduces the cooldown of your Vanish and Blind abilities by 90 sec.

talents.name: Camouflage
ranks: Reduces your speed penalty from your Stealth ability by 15% and reduces its cooldown by 6 sec.

talents.name: Initiative
ranks: Gives you a 100% chance to add an additional combo point to your target when using your Ambush, Garrote, or Cheap Shot ability.

talents.name: Ghostly Strike
ranks: A strike that deals 125% (180% if a Dagger is equipped in your Main Hand) weapon damage, increases your chance to dodge by 15% for 7 sec, and causes your next Ambush or Garrote cast within 7 sec to not require Stealth. Awards 1 combo point.

talents.name: Improved Ambush
ranks: Increases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by 45%.

talents.name: Setup
ranks: Gives you a 0% chance to add a Combo Point to your target after Dodging their attack or fully resisting one of their spells.

talents.name: Improved Sap
ranks: Gives you a 30% chance to return to stealth mode after using your Sap ability.
Gives you a 60% chance to return to stealth mode after using your Sap ability.
Gives you a 90% chance to return to stealth mode after using your Sap ability.

talents.name: Serrated Blades
ranks: Causes your attacks to ignore 9% of your target's Armor and increases the damage dealt by your Rupture ability by 30%.

talents.name: Heightened Senses
ranks: Increases your Stealth detection as if you were 3 levels higher and reduces your chance to be hit by spells and ranged attacks by 6%.

talents.name: Preparation
ranks: When activated, this ability immediately finishes the cooldown on your other Rogue abilities.

talents.name: Dirty Deeds
ranks: Reduces the Energy cost of your Cheap Shot and Garrote abilities by 20, and your Garrote ability no longer requires you to be behind your target.

talents.name: Hemorrhage
ranks: An instant strike that deals 100% weapon damage (145% if a Dagger is equipped) and causes the target to take 15% increased Rupture and Garrote damage from the Rogue. Lasts 15 sec. Awards 1 Combo Point.

talents.name: Deadliness
ranks: Increases your Attack Power by 10%.

talents.name: Premeditation
ranks: Adds 2 Combo Points to your target. You must add to or use those combo points within 20 sec or the combo points are lost.
